item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows a cell used in Kavya's torch. Its electrolyte is held as a moist paste, not as a free liquid, and the cell is easy to carry for everyday use.

Which classification is correct?

options.A: It is a dry cell because the electrolyte is not a free liquid, which makes it convenient for everyday use.
options.B: It is a Voltaic cell because any cell with two terminals and an electrolyte is a Voltaic cell.
options.C: It is a Voltaic cell because a paste electrolyte is used only in Voltaic cells.
options.D: It is a dry cell only when placed in a torch, not when used in any other device.
